title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode6 A Dream I Can't Abandon

meta.Episode: Episode6 — A Dream I Can't Abandon
meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_idol_op3
Streaming Room

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
It's Nanamin!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Today, we're gonna do that joint stream I mentioned the other day! And I've called over a special guest!!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
So, let's have her enter!
Come on in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay!
Lovely☆ Fairy☆ Airi... Momoi!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's me, Airi Momoi!
Thanks for having me! I promise to do my best for the Nanamin Channel today!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Finallyyyy!!>
<I've been waiting for this joint stream!!!>
<I'm so happy!!!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're bouncing off the walls right from the start!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Of course they are!
You're one of the most famous streamers out there, Airi, and you're here!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<This is gonna be so good.>
<We're counting on you, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You got it!
I'm gonna give everyone, including your fans, Nanamin, a huge blast of happy energy♪

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Oh, you sound all wound up and ready to go! So, Airi, here's the segment we'll be doing today!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: It's called “Get Stuffed on a Famous Shop's Newest Donuts♡”!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Woohoo!>
<The wait is over!>
<Those donuts look amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That sounds pretty boilerplate.>
<I thought they were gonna do something more interesting.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Not so fast, you guys.
You don't honestly expect us to just sit here and eat them, do you?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Remember how we've been asking you all to send in questions to us on social media? Today, we're going to answer them while having these donuts☆

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Now I see.>
<I sent in a question!>
<Are the donuts really necessary?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, because we wanted to have some!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm looking forward to a fun convo!>
<Are you gonna do this as Happy Everyday?>
<Do a Happy Snacker while you eat!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Even Nanamin's listeners want me to do those things...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start digging in...
And while I'm at it, I'll do that thing.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nom!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmm♡ This is so yummy♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's that thing she does to look cute even when she eats really weird stuff! It's...!>
<Yes, she did a Happy Snacker!>
<Isn't she just sticking out her tongue...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, don't scoff at my Happy Snacker!
Do you know how many years I spent polishing this technique?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can nail this angle while every single time I stick my tongue out!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Bahaha...!
What did you spend that much time on?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Oh no... We're getting totally sucked into Airi's world...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If this keeps up, Nanamin, all of your listeners are gonna be eating out of my hand because of my cuteness♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yes, gladly.>
<You're breaking character, Momoi.>
<Can you guys start answering questions already?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Looks like they can't wait. Alright, that leaves us no choice. Let's munching and munching and munching away at these!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Wait, don't you mean answering and answering and answering?! I can't let you just eat...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm kidding!
Anyway, this one's from SasamiFLY...
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our next question says, “Did anything happen recently which made you really happy?”

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, what's this?>
<Did you learn a new Happy technique?>
<That's totally a possibility lol>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll have to go with hitting all green lights on my way to school...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Oh, that's simple but really good!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See? Appreciating all the little things in life is key to living every day in a happy way!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wise words!>
<Well put, Happy Everyday.>
<It's deep but also not!>

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Alright, with Airi's nice words of wisdom...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: As much as I don't want to, it's time to wrap things up.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Nooo!>
<I wanna hear you two talk some more!>
<Please keep going!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't wanna stop either, you guys, but don't worry! A second joint stream is already in the works!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Woohoo!>
<Let's go right now!>
<What are you doing next time?>

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Its contents are still a secret!
But our next one will involve me popping over to Airi's channel!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come tune in if you guys are interested!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: But for now...

rows.Speaker: Airi & Nanamin
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Phew! Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That went really well.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Yeah, I also had a lot of fun! I almost forgot that I was streaming!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You even laughed so hard during for a second that you couldn't talk, Nanamin.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: That's because you were so funny when you talked about your three worst ever on-site shoots!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: There was the time you had to do Happy Side Steps in order to out-intimidate a few animals, and the time where, even though it was the day before a concert, you had you couldn't leave that diner until you ate everything on the menu...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly, they were hardly things that you should be asking an idol to do... I remember running like crazy in order to maintain my figure because there really was no time left until that show...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: That must've been so hard.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: On the other hand, I'm a little jealous since I've never really experienced those kinds of situations.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and they ended up being good experiences since the viewers seemed to enjoy what I did...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
In any case, thanks for inviting me on today!
I'm looking forward to our next joint stream.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Me too! Oh, what if we did a dance video next time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? A dance video...?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
I actually really love the ones you post, Airi.
Particularly because the routines you do are so powerful, but you always look adorable whenever you stick the landing.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Which is why I want my viewers to also see the way you dance, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks...
I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But... I have a feeling that everyone wants me to talk about stuff and do funny things, like what I used to do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A lot of people said that in the comments today, remember?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
And I get how they feel since you always tell the funniest stories and give the funniest reactions.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Then, we can talk about more stuff we've done next time, and leave dancing for another day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... We could also step outside and go shopping for something. Wouldn't they like it if we had a battle to see who can put together the best outfits?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: That's a great idea! There's actually this shop I've been meaning to visit...
A few hours later
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad that our joint stream ended up going so well.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But it also showed me that nothing has changed since back then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (All that hard work for...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nanamin sent me an email?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh... The boutique she said was on the top of her list gave us the green light to shoot.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Alright, I guess that means our outfit battle is all set to go.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Nanamin's probably gonna come up with some really trendy ones, so I should try to draw out reactions from everyone by going for something a little different...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've gotta come up with some good ideas and make sure I don't disappoint them.)

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Me too! Oh, what if we did a dance video next time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I mean, someday, I'll...)
One year earlier

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's posted...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (There's no going back now...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I let down all of my fans by stepping away from being an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I can't give up on my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This is the start of a new journey.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I have to make up for disappointing everyone by making things more fun than ever before.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And then, I'll make my dream come true by...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<No way! Airi's doing a dance video?!>
<Is that really Happy Everyday?>
<Wait, didn't she retire?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh... So many comments already...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I've never seen her dance before.>
<I didn't realize she was such a good dancer!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <This is so cute! It's really cheering me up!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My dance is cheering them up...?
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (My dance and singing videos have stopped gaining any traction.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The first one got a lot of attention, but everything after that...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I think I'll just stream myself talking about random stuff today.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My stream from yesterday made it into the trend rankings?! But why? That's never happened before...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This next one says, “I love seeing you dance, Airi, but I also really loved Happy Everyday. I miss seeing you as her”...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
“Me too!”
“I wanna see Happy Everyday again.”
“Do one of your Happy moves!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (What...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (My plan was to never do any of that stuff again...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But if it'll make them happy, then maybe just for a little bit.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Long time no see, you guys!
It's me, the Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yes!!!>
<I associate you more with this than being an idol, Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, whoa!
Have you forgotten that Happy Everyday is also an idol?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you keep saying stuff like that, then you're gonna get a Happy Idol Punch straight through the screen!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Is that why it's trending...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess this is what they want to see from me.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It makes sense since most of my fans began supporting me after seeing me on all those variety shows...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But as for my image as an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (No, it's not that.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's just that the only endearing part of my performances was my talent for talking.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (For now, I just want to not disappoint everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But as long as I keep polishing my skills, someday, I'll...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Become the kind of idol I wanted to be...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've been working hard ever since, but nothing has changed about what people say about me.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Still, as an idol, I want to keep spreading hope to others...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So, in order to get them to focus more on my singing and dancing...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll start by practicing my moves. One, two, three, four...
